scripts.docs:dev: cd docs && bun install --concurrent-scripts=1 && bun run dev
scripts.docs:build: cd docs && bun install --concurrent-scripts=1 && bun run build
scripts.docs:preview: cd docs && bun install --concurrent-scripts=1 && bun run preview
scripts.install:clean:win: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path node_modules) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules }; if (Test-Path bun.lock) { Remove-Item -Force bun.lock }; bun pm cache rm; bun install --concurrent-scripts=1"
scripts.docs:clean:win: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force docs\node_modules, docs\bun.lock, docs\.vitepress\cache, docs\.vitepress\dist -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
scripts.docs:reinstall:win: bun run docs:clean:win && cd docs && bun install --concurrent-scripts=1 --optional
